subject: BlueBridge — forecast data tidy & commit verification
summary: Requested clean-up of five deals that are blocking the Q4 commit: normalize SKUs, confirm ARR amounts, update next steps and set probability. Internal owners assigned and external contacts asked to confirm by EOD 10/05.
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluebridgelogistics.com>, Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@bluebridgelogistics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: BlueBridge — forecast data tidy & commit verification

Hi Ethan / Natalie,

Quick note from our forecasting team — we ran a pass on the Q4 pipeline and flagged five opportunities where details look inconsistent for the commit window. To avoid surprises in the Friday close, can you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday 10/05?

Summary of asks (attached as CSV):
- Confirm current ARR amount on each opportunity (currency and whether MRR/annualized).
- Verify the Product/SKU mapped to the opportunity (we saw two entries with ambiguous SKU names).
- Confirm the immediate next step and expected close week.
- Set a probability % consistent with your internal procurement readiness.

Attachments: BBL_pipeline_export_20271003.csv — contains row-by-row notes.

We (Vivek & Laura here) will update the commit lines in the CRM once you confirm. If it's easier, happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow morning.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluebridgelogistics.com>

Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueBridge — forecast data tidy & commit verification

Hi Soojin — thanks for the heads up. I pulled the CSV and started a pass; a couple of quick items below:

- Opp BBL-348: ARR shows $120k in our CRM but the contract they discussed in procurement is for $90k (annualized). I'll confirm which number legal will sign off on.
- Opp BBL-362: SKU listed as "Analytics Pro" and "AnalyticsPRO" in two rows — will normalize to the official SKU code and confirm.
- Opp BBL-377: Procurement requested a PO rather than SOW — probability should be downgraded to 40% unless PO arrives this week.

I can confirm everything by EOD tomorrow. If Laura / Vivek want to update anything in HubSpot directly, tell me which fields you need toggled and we can grant access.

On call availability: 10/05 between 09:00-11:00 PT works for us.

—Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of Procurement, BlueBridge Logistics
ethan.cole@bluebridgelogistics.com

Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueBridge — forecast data tidy & commit verification

Thanks Ethan — quick note on our side so everyone's aligned:

Operational asks for HubSpot fields we want updated (so updates are deterministic):
- Close Date: set to ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- Amount: currency + numeric value in ARR (no MRR).
- SKU: use canonical SKU codes from our product catalog (we included a mapping tab in the Google Sheet link).
- Next Step: short phrase from list: {PO Requested, Legal Review, Exec Approval, Pilot Sign-off}.
- Probability: numeric percent.

If you prefer, we can apply the changes and mark them with a "confirmed_by_partner" tag so auditability is preserved. I'll wait for Ethan's confirmations and then run the hubspot patch.

Attached: MPA_redlines_annotated.pdf (for reference on billing terms)

-Vivek
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@bluebridgelogistics.com>

Hi all — I completed the first pass this morning and left inline notes in the spreadsheet. Highlights:

- BBL-348: Confirmed by legal — final ARR to record is $90,000 (annual).
- BBL-362: Canonical SKU is RB-ANL-STD. Please update both rows to this value.
- BBL-371: Duplicate opportunity discovered; engineers merged work into BBL-371 and closed BBL-373 (please archive the duplicate).
- BBL-377: Procurement said PO is expected next week; moving probability to 40% as Ethan suggested.
- BBL-395: We need a billing contact — I'll add Samir Patel to the contact list today.

I've shared edit rights on the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcD_example_sheet (see tab "BBL Q4 cleanup").

Thanks — Natalie

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround and the edits, Natalie. Action items on our side: 

- Laura will merge your canonical SKUs into HubSpot and remove the duplicate (BBL-373) by EOD 10/05.
- Vivek will update ARR amounts and set the probability fields according to the sheet.
- I'll leave a note on the deal records pointing to the MPA_redlines_annotated.pdf and the Google Sheet for auditors.

If anything changes on the PO timing we can re-open probability adjustments, but assuming current inputs the commit for H2/Q4 will reflect these numbers. I'll confirm in tomorrow's commit email.

Thanks all —
Soojin
